frequency_question: How often do threatened indefinite strikes by major bank union federations result in actual indefinite strikes being initiated rather than averted or deferred within the target window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide strike calls by coalition of bank unions affecting national payment and clearing operations. Excludes single-bank localized strikes or non-banking public sector strikes.
provenance_note: claims 12 cases from only 3 named (4.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 3 named major episodes; estimated 12 comparable escalation cycles in total where formal strike dates were set.
known_gaps: Excludes minor one-day token strikes which are distinct from indefinite strike threats.
skeleton: Total major nationwide banking strike notices issued by UFBU resulting in actual multi-day or indefinite strikes versus those settled or deferred through conciliation prior to the deadline.
multiplier: 3 strikes executed out of approximately 12 serious strike notices issued by UFBU over the last 15 years.
validity_reason: Labor laws and federation structures in the target sector remain stable over multi-year periods.
